archetypes.name: publish-race
archetypes.rationale: Concurrent publish retry behavior crosses shell result parsing and summary rendering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design publish retry paths for race windows. Focus on result-env lock acquisition, write-once eligibility, and the summary downgrade checks. Verify validation and plan-write failures cannot preserve stale publish success. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: log-branch
archetypes.rationale: Final and pause design-log publish modes now share remote branch detection with different branch bases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design-log publish mode separation. Confirm final idempotency works after squash-merge branch deletion, final worktrees do not reuse pause branches, and pause behavior remains fail-closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
